searchLog: 7th consecutive day (Aug 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, now Aug 11) of total WebFetch egress block in this environment. Re-confirmed domain-agnostic before giving up: attempts against www.anthropic.com/careers/jobs, job-boards.greenhouse.io (anthropic and togetherai boards), api.ashbyhq.com (openai and reflectionai boards), metacareers.com, stripe.com, ramp.com, notion.com, and two neutral controls (example.com, en.wikipedia.org) all returned the identical structured error {"error_type":"EGRESS_BLOCKED","message":"Access to <domain> is blocked by the network egress proxy."}. A direct curl to anthropic.com also returned HTTP 403 despite anthropic.com being present in the proxy's own no_proxy allowlist. WebSearch still works (surfaced OpenAI's Applied Emerging Talent internship posting, among others) but per the honesty rules a search snippet cannot confirm a posting is open now, eligible, and free of hidden requirements — that requires loading the real page, which remains impossible from inside this run. Zero verified opportunities is the correct output under these conditions, not a search failure. This is now a 7-day unresolved pattern with no sign of self-resolving; it needs a fix at the environment/routine network-policy level (allowlist greenhouse.io, ashbyhq.com, lever.co, and target company career-page domains for WebFetch), since it cannot be worked around from inside a run.
